notice: NON-CANONICAL staging contract for box-snapshot-20260818: declares the required staging closure, the exact text/literal/symlink mappings, the allowed exact-build binaries, the current blockers, the no-fallback policy, and the output schema; derived from the sanitized public payload manifest and the reproducibility status record only

inputs.repo_text_sources: current harmony-hub-control working tree (repo-relative paths only)
inputs.build_output_dir: caller-supplied directory of fresh source-built binaries (--build-output-dir); optional

required_closure.policy: every live entry of public-payload-manifest/1 except the excluded stale live MANIFEST.txt must be staged with exact bytes, size, mode, and symlink target verified against the live manifest, or reported as a blocker; a staging with any blocker is incomplete

excluded_live_paths.detail: the live listing is stale and incoherent (4 hash/size mismatches, 1 live binary missing from the listing); it is never staged; a fresh legacy MANIFEST.txt is generated only for a complete staging

allowed_exact_build_binaries.policy: a live binary is staged only when its build_status in reproducibility-status.json is EXACT_SOURCE_REPRODUCIBLE and a regular file named build_output_name in the caller-supplied build-output dir matches the live SHA-256 and size; this declared set must equal the live binary paths whose build_status is EXACT_SOURCE_REPRODUCIBLE
allowed_exact_build_binaries.derivation: recomputed from reproducibility-status.json at every run; a disagreement is a contract failure, not a silent difference

blockers.policy: every closure entry that cannot be staged is omitted with an exact reason code plus the live build_status and source_provenance from reproducibility-status.json; a staging with any blocker is incomplete and fails closed unless --allow-partial is given

reason_codes.NO_SOURCE_BUILD_OUTPUT: build_status is EXACT_SOURCE_REPRODUCIBLE but no qualifying source-built artifact was supplied
reason_codes.BUILD_OUTPUT_MISMATCH: a source-built artifact was supplied but its SHA-256 or size does not match the live entry
reason_codes.SOURCE_TEXT_MISSING: the mapped repository text source is absent
reason_codes.SOURCE_TEXT_MISMATCH: the mapped repository text source is not byte-identical to the live entry

no_fallback_policy.tracked_payload_bin: the tool never reads the repository payload/bin tree and never falls back to it; a binary without a qualifying source-built artifact in the build-output dir is omitted with a blocker, never sourced from tracked payload/bin
build_output_dir_requirements: must exist and be a directory when supplied
must not be, or be inside, the repository payload/bin tree (checked lexically and through symlinks)
must not overlap the out-dir in either direction
binary artifacts must be regular files; symlinks in the build-output dir are refused
out_dir_safety: must not be the filesystem root
must not be the repository root or inside the repository payload/, provenance/, docs/, tools/, .git/, or .slim/ trees (checked lexically and through symlinks)
live paths are materialized only after validation: absolute, normalized, no '..' segments, and confined to the rootfs directory

legacy_manifest.format: one '<md5sum>  <name>' line per required binary (two spaces, lowercase hex), LF-terminated, in the declared binaries order
legacy_manifest.emit_policy: a fresh legacy MANIFEST.txt is emitted only for a complete staging, which requires every required binary to be source-reproducible (EXACT_SOURCE_REPRODUCIBLE) and present as a matching source-built artifact; it is never emitted for a partial staging and the stale live MANIFEST.txt bytes are never staged

outputs.json: canonical JSON: sorted keys, 2-space indent, ASCII, LF-terminated; no wall-clock timestamps; determinism is inherited from the input digests

exit_codes.0: complete staging published (rootfs plus all manifests)
exit_codes.2: usage, input, contract, or safety failure; nothing published
exit_codes.4: incomplete staging without --allow-partial: fail closed, no rootfs published; diagnostic staging-manifest.json and blockers.json are written

public_safety.note: the legacy MANIFEST.txt rootfs file (emitted only for a complete staging) carries MD5 digests by the on-hub browser/update contract; no generated manifest ever does
